entries.name: Ronald Bridgeforth

expected_cases.charges: Assault with a deadly weapon — September 1968 confrontation with police at a White Front store in San Francisco; pleaded guilty, then fled before sentencing in 1969 and lived underground as Cole Jordan for 42 years
expected_cases.sentence:
One year in county jail (March 2012)

Verdict as recorded: Yes — plea; surrendered November 2011 and was sentenced in March 2012 to one year in county jail

expected_cases.charges: Murder (charged in absentia as the ninth San Francisco 8 defendant, 1971 killing of SFPD Sgt. John Young)
expected_cases.sentence: Verdict as recorded: No — the charge was not pursued after his 2011 surrender; the SF8 prosecution had largely collapsed

updates.charges: Refusal to submit to fingerprinting and booking photographs; contempt of court (Starkville, Mississippi)
updates.sentence: Jailed in Starkville during his COFO voter-registration work after requesting legal advice before fingerprinting and booking photographs. Contemporary legal reports describe two successive contempt penalties of one day in jail and a $50 fine, imposed August 14 and 15, 1964. The November legal docket records fingerprinting and payment of fines on August 16 but does not explicitly date physical release. Arrest and custody start are recorded at month precision because the contemporary reports differ between August 12 and 13. This is a separate episode from the later California prosecution.

entries.rationale: Contemporary Columbus legal report PDF pages 6-8 and LDF November 1964 docket PDF page 13 establish actual multiday Starkville jail custody and successive contempt findings. Original scans inspected. August 12 versus 13 arrest discrepancy retained at month precision; August 16 fine payment is not asserted as release. Identity is corroborated by Bridgeforth own 2013 account and contemporaneous project roster. LDF mislabels his race; that label is not copied. All existing cases and biography preserved.
